reason: I already pay for therapy and medication and every monthly fee gets weighed hard. An AirTag or a kids' watch covers most of what this does for a fraction of the money, and $249 plus $25 a month is more than I can justify for a safety line I may never use.
objection: Would it really connect the moment he runs, or is it another gadget that fails when I need it most? I cannot afford to find out after the trial.
would_change_my_mind: Proof from a family with a wandering child that the SOS and the location updates work reliably in the places he actually goes, plus a lower device price or a plan I can pause.
